propositions: Pydantic tolerant parsing can normalize structurally divergent provider output to semantically empty results that are incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes

Semantically empty verification responses arise via two paths: raw-empty (provider sends nothing) and malformed-to-empty (provider sends garbage that does not survive reshape), and both must be rejected

The verification pipeline already enforces rejection of semantically empty results at the decision layer via pass3_decide's no-verification rule, which treats any finding without a verification entry as indeterminate

Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets: clean parses, recovered parses, empty outcomes, and unrecoverable responses; kernel-level telemetry is shipped but pipeline-level wiring into live consumers is incomplete
Flexible parsing and bounded self-healing must be preserved while rejecting empty outcomes; schema rigidity risks fragility across provider and model versions
